replies.text: Noted: your shop is in Denver, Colorado.
Got it: your customers love Patagonia, Carhartt and Tyler Childers.
Matched 22 of 25 brands. Qloo doesn't know Graza, so I'll leave it out rather than guess.
Quick check: by "Le Labo" do you mean Le Labo Fragrances? (Le Labo Fragrances is a niche perfume and candle brand known for hand-formulated perfumes, slow perfumery, …)
Quick check: by "Kapital" do you mean Kapital Bank? (Kapital Bank is a leading commercial bank in Azerbaijan, offering retail and corporate banking services wit…)

Drop #01 is ready: 7 to stock, 9 to consider, 7 to skip. Top picks: Stanley, Filson, Hydro Flask and Topo Designs. A generic bestseller list would have made the opposite call on Stanley, HAY, Aesop and Ganni. That is where your crowd differs from the average shopper.
